Upgrade daily countertop organization with a wall mount tumbler toothbrush holder crafted from solid brass and designed to save space in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. - Included: Toothbrush holder and installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
